Package model.independent

Class CyclicMap<K,V>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
java.util.IdentityHashMap<K,V>
model.independent.CyclicMap<K,V>
Type Parameters:
V - Class of objects contained.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Map<K,V>
public class CyclicMap<K,V> extends IdentityHashMap<K,V>
A map that can be cycled through in the order that the keys and values have been added to it.

  • Constructor Details

    • CyclicMap

      public CyclicMap(Collection<Map.Entry<K,V>> collection)
      Constructs a new cyclic map from the collection given and also ordered in the same way as that collection. That is one has to maintain the ordering oneself and be able to insert according to that. This will probably change soon. NOT IMPLEMENTED YET: This ordering is not decided yet so a collection orderedanyhow could be given for the moment. The implementation is now a based on a hash map wich must have orderable keys secure to collision detection but that is not used as ordering but the ordering exported by is the order of addition and insertion.
      Parameters:
      collection - A collection objects of class T.
